            2. _Zac Chevalier_, Jul 16, 2026, 1/5: "Literally every time I sign in, I need to send a verification code. Why include a "remember this device" option if it never works? They've managed to make it worse. edit2: another half year and it continues to get worse. No fix for the previous complaints and the app frequently freezes now. Force shutdown ftw"
